hypotheses.description: The two products are spatially misaligned (e.g., a shift or rotation) causing low agreement despite both being valid.
One product has a systematic offset (e.g., calibration bias) that reduces agreement without affecting spatial structure.
A silent processing error (e.g., wrong variable, unit conversion, or masking) corrupted one product, lowering agreement.
The agreement of 0.60 is scientifically valid for these products; no fault exists.
